messages:
Aisha Carter: Hey team — Nightingale Health asked for a short enablement 'mini-lab' to walk through onboarding gaps before their renewal. They want a 30-min hands-on session (focused configs + quick troubleshooting) next week. Can we propose 3 slot options and owners?

Marco Ruiz: I can own the infra bits and run the lab demo. Proposed slots: Tue 10:00-10:30 PT, Wed 16:00-16:30 PT, Fri 09:00-09:30 PT. Prefer Tue/Wed.

Priya Nair: I can cover prompt design + eval checklist. Tue works for me too.

Lena Zhou: That's great — Nightingale prefers mornings PT. Could we offer Mon 11:00 or Tue 10:00 as primary? I'll confirm with their PM but want to keep options tight (they're worried about renewal timeline).

Aisha Carter: Ok locking candidates: Mon 11:00 PT, Tue 10:00 PT, Fri 09:00 PT. Agenda draft: 1) 5m intros, 2) 15m hands-on walk through their staging app hitting Redwood Dedicated, 3) 5m quick perf & cost tips, 4) 5m Q&A + next steps. Anything to add?

Marco Ruiz: Add a 2-min checklist for staging creds and network (we lost 10 min on last call because the KV cache wasn't enabled). Quick prep snippet I usually send:

```
# staging prep checklist
export REDWOOD_ENDPOINT=https://dedicated.redwood.example
export REDWOOD_KEY=sk-…
# confirm KV_CACHE=true in runtime config
```

Priya Nair: Also include a short prompt-eval quick test (3 sample prompts) so we can check quality regressions live. I'll paste them into the shared doc beforehand.

Lena Zhou: Confirmed with Nightingale — they can do Tue 10:00 PT or Fri 09:00 PT. They're leaning to Tue. They asked for a recording and the short checklist ahead of time.

Aisha Carter: Great. I'll send calendar invite for Tue 10:00 PT with both recording + prep checklist. Assigning roles: Marco = demo infra + staging prep, Priya = prompt tests + evaluation walk-through, Aisha = facilitation + renewal risk notes.

Tom Ellis: FYI, renewal FYI: account shows mid-risk (usage dip last 30d). Capture any blockers so AE can follow up post-session.

Lena Zhou: Nightingale wants a 10-min follow-up in two weeks to validate changes. Please put that on the invite as optional.

Aisha Carter: Will do. Draft invite notes: 
- Recording will be shared within 24h
- Prep checklist attached (Marco)
- Live prompt tests (Priya)
- Follow-up 10m sync in 2w (optional)

deploy-bot: calendar: event created "Nightingale — Mini lab: onboarding + perf check" Tue 10:00 PT — guests: lena.z,nightingale-pm, marco.r, priya.n, aisha.c

Priya Nair: Small ask — can we reserve 15 min after the session for an internal 1:1 to capture action items? I'll ping ops for a quick notes doc.

Aisha Carter: Yes — reserved 15m private slot 10:30-10:45 PT. I'll add link to CS tracker and AE deal notes: https://cs-tracker.example/redwood/NIGHT-42

Marco Ruiz: All set on infra side, will send the checklist to the invite and paste the `KV_CACHE` tip in the notes. :thumbsup:

Lena Zhou: Sending to Nightingale PM now. Thanks all.

Aisha Carter: ✅ Closing — invite out, recording + checklist promised, internal post-mortem slot reserved. I'll follow up if Nightingale asks to swap to Fri.
